newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberdrola still interested in EDP strategic deal.
newsitem.headline: Iberdrola still interested in EDP strategic deal.

text.p: Spanish electricity firm Iberdrola is still interested in a strategic deal with Portugal's EDP, although this would not necessarily require Iberdrola buying a stake, a spokesman told Reuters on Friday.
"Iberdrola is still fully interested in establishing a strategic agreement with EDP, which would not have to include taking a stake," the spokesman said.
"In parallel with our official offer in the privatisation talks were opened to reach a substantial agreement, in which the extent of the collaboration will be established," he added.
Iberdrola and rival Endesa were interested in taking a stake in the Portuguese firm at its privatisation, although they are unlikely to have received any shares, according to press reports.
The Portuguese state sold 30 percent of EDP to private and institutional investors in a sale which finished on Monday, although no single investor received more than one percent.
